name: Marque
description: An editorial brand identity and design system handbook with deep violet ink, layered lavender surfaces, and confident geometric typography.
concept: Marque treats a product as a published brand book: oversized display type leading every page, generous lavender margins, and a striped indigo signature mark that ties identity, photography, typography, and components into one premium grammar.

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Primary page background — warm white with the faintest lavender cast

palette.name: Veil
palette.role: Lavender surface for cards, swatches, and editorial blocks

palette.name: Indigo
palette.role: Primary brand violet for marks, links, and key actions

palette.name: Royal
palette.role: Deep brand block used for hero panels and signature surfaces

palette.name: Halo
palette.role: Secondary accent for highlights, focus, and chart strokes

palette.name: Hairline
palette.role: Borders, dividers, and quiet rule lines

fonts.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
fonts.usage: Display headings, oversized editorial type, and prominent labels

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.usage: Body copy, supporting text, controls, and metadata

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.usage: Token codes, hex values, and specimen captions

iconPack.name: Lucide
iconPack.usage: Used for interface, action, and feature icons throughout the brand handbook.
